name: Akarui Miyako
source:
Akarui Miyako is one of the four main girls in Midnight Moon.

FUN FACTS:

-Akarui is SpringingTraps' personal favorite.

-Akarui's bubbly, airheaded personality was heavily inspired by [url=/c64503]Sayori[/url] from [url=/v21905]Doki Doki Literature Club[/url] and Midori Gurin from Yandere Simulator. However, her love for puzzles was inspired by Papyrus from Undertale.
